subject.title: fix(security): bound plugin manifest reads in audit deep scan

question: Should deep security audit enforce a 1 MiB ceiling for installed plugin package.json reads?
rationale: The bounded-read mechanism follows the dependency contract, but the exact maximum determines when valid plugin metadata stops contributing declared entrypoints to deep scan, so repository evidence cannot safely choose that policy value without security-owner intent.

options.title: Approve 1 MiB
options.body: Adopt the proposed strict ceiling and merge the focused hardening patch after required checks complete.

options.title: Choose Another Ceiling
options.body: Select a different maximum and update the focused regression test and real CLI proof to match it.

recommendation.title: Approve 1 MiB
recommendation.body: Adopt the proposed strict ceiling and merge the focused hardening patch after required checks complete.
